tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Return the details of one plan from Wireless Choices by plan type, provider slug and plan slug, including inclusions, current promotion terms and the link to its detail page. A plan is identified by its plan type, provider slug and plan slug.

tools.name: compare_plans
tools.description: Compare two to four plans from Wireless Choices side by side on price, data, network or technology, speed, contract and inclusions. Each plan is identified by its plan type, provider slug and plan slug.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List the telco providers currently listed on Wireless Choices, with the network each one sells access to and how many plans of each type are listed. Each provider is returned with its name and slug.
